meta.name: CI Fix Loop
meta.description: Read the failing checks of a dazl-pr-panel-sandbox branch or pull request, fix the cause, and re-run npm test and npm run build until they pass or the run is blocked.

nodes.title: Start with failing checks
nodes.description: Name the pull request number or URL, or leave it out to use the checked-out branch.

nodes.title: Fix the failing checks
nodes.description: Read the failures, find each root cause, fix it, re-run the checks.
nodes.prompt: Fix the failing checks for the branch or pull request in the request. Done when npm test and npm run build both pass in dazl-pr-panel-sandbox/, or when you set outcome status blocked with the failure that remains and why.

nodes.title: Verify the checks are green
nodes.description: Re-runs every check; each remaining failure sends the fixer another round.

reviewers.prompt: Run npm ci, npm test and npm run build in dazl-pr-panel-sandbox/ and check the fix did not weaken any test. Report each failure as a blocker finding.
